cases.description: Find similar playable game repositories for a 3D military automatic runner shooter with a growing soldier squad, arithmetic gates, obstacles and armored-vehicle Bosses. 数字门枪手：连续前进、加减乘除门、自动射击、人数变化。
Find a real top-down survivors game repository with automatic combat, enemy waves, XP and gold pickups, level-up choices and upgrade progression. 武林幸存者、武侠幸存者、弹幕生存与自动战斗。
Find a 3D open-field numerical power-growth game repository: click a weaker enemy, move, compare power, defeat and absorb it, collect weapons and reach a final Boss. 百炼英雄要求开放场地，不能改成塔楼玩法，没有常规HP战斗。

Find extractable waypoint-movement implementations or algorithm references compatible with a Phaser web game. The host owns entity state and simulation timing. Return multiple alternatives with relevant source paths and dependency information.
requiredBehavior: Move enemies along ordered 2D waypoints using elapsed simulation time.
Handle crossing multiple waypoints within one update.
Emit a goal-reached event once per enemy.

cases.description: Find enemy wave scheduling source code: use elapsed time, cap active enemies, grow spawn frequency and difficulty over a survivors run. 波次、定时刷怪、场上敌人数上限。
requiredBehavior: Schedule enemy spawns from simulation time.
Bound active enemy count and increase wave difficulty.

cases.description: Find nearest-enemy targeting and target selection code. Filter dead enemies and order valid targets by distance before automatic attacks. 最近敌人索敌和目标选择。
requiredBehavior: Choose a valid nearby enemy and ignore defeated entities.
Expose distance and targeting assumptions for adaptation.

cases.description: Find automatic cooldown combat and projectile collision damage source code, including reuse/deactivation of bullets. 自动战斗、武器冷却、子弹碰撞伤害和对象池。
requiredBehavior: Apply hit damage through explicit collision/lifecycle handling.

cases.description: Find gold economy and permanent-upgrade purchase source code. Record earned gold, check affordability, deduct purchase costs and preserve state on a rejected purchase. 金币经济、消费校验、永久升级。
requiredBehavior: Check available currency before a purchase.
Persist earned gold and purchased upgrade state.

cases.description: Find experience level-up and skill-upgrade progression source code, with a choice UI or unlock conditions for a survivors game. 经验升级、技能选择与解锁进度。
requiredBehavior: Accumulate experience and trigger level-up choices.
Keep skill evolution and unlock requirements inspectable.
